hooks.name: Run media-service tests on change
hooks.description: Run media-service tests when media_service code changes (the component the fix agent patches)

action.prompt: media-service Python file saved. Run `cd media-service && ../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` to check regression tests. If tests fail, this may indicate a bad patch was applied by the Fix agent — diagnose whether the failure is in the fix or the test, report clearly, and suggest a correction.
